# TICK-1205 slot plans (EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, SETTINGS) as nava_app, one run per cell)

### S-b2 (i) broad 50% (pk 3), no ACL, group index only

```sql
SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, d.key, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
       r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
       r.data, r.causation_origin_id, coalesce(r.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       r.updated_at::text FROM records r
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND d.id = r.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND g.id = r.assignment_group_id
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $3::uuid) OR (r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $4::uuid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $5::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($6::uuid[]))))) OR true) AND (r.fx_num_2 = $8::double precision AND $7::uuid IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $9
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
```

```sql
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10

LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id

ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,

       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND r.fx_num_1 < $10::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $11)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND r.fx_num_1 < $10::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $11)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND r.fx_num_1 < $10::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $11)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 >= $9::double precision AND r.fx_num_1 < $10::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $11)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $11
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,

       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)

) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = ANY($9::text[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = ANY($9::text[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = ANY($9::text[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = ANY($9::text[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = ANY($9::double precision[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = ANY($9::double precision[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = ANY($9::double precision[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = ANY($9::double precision[]) AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_1 < $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_text_1 = $9::text COLLATE "C" AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $36)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $36
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_own = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_own = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_own = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_own = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_own = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, d.key, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
```

```sql
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

```sql
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,

  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
```

```sql
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $14)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $14)
```
```sql
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $14
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```

### S-b3 2M, broad 50% (pk 3), a6, compiled (b)+group

```sql
SELECT x.tenant_id, x.id, x.entity_definition_id, d.key, x.version, x.schema_version, x.number, x.state,
       x.requester_id, x.assignee_id, x.assignment_group_id, x.org_unit_id, x.created_by, x.created_at, x.updated_at,
       x.data, x.causation_origin_id, coalesce(x.causation_depth, 0), coalesce(g.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, false),
       x.sort_key::text FROM (
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[])))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND (((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.entity_definition_id, r.version, r.schema_version, r.number, r.state,
  r.requester_id, r.assignee_id, r.assignment_group_id, r.org_unit_id, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
  r.data, r.causation_origin_id, r.causation_depth, r.updated_at AS sort_key FROM records r
WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.entity_definition_id = $2 AND (r.fx_num_2 = $9::double precision AND $8::uuid IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_shares acl_share WHERE acl_share.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND acl_share.record_id = r.id AND ((acl_share.principal_kind = 'user' AND acl_share.principal_id = $6::uuid) OR (acl_share.principal_kind = 'group' AND acl_share.principal_id = ANY($7::uuid[]))))) AND NOT ((r.assignment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignment_group_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))) AND NOT ((r.requester_id IS NOT NULL AND r.requester_id = $4::uuid)) AND NOT ((r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assignee_id = $5::uuid))) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST, r.id DESC LIMIT $10)
ORDER BY sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT $10
) x
JOIN entity_definitions d ON d.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND d.id = x.entity_definition_id
LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND g.id = x.assignment_group_id
ORDER BY x.sort_key DESC NULLS FIRST, x.id DESC
```
